evidence_layout: one fresh directory per cell; must not exist before the run

input_record.fields: unchanged from K1R5 (affine [p,'0/1'] left/right/e0/rho/C_evaluation; C_upper 'num/den'; index in {1000, 1001}; detector 'CUSUM')
identities: identity resolver record == certified cell (checked before certify)
input_record.source: K1R4 config/CUSUM_BRIDGE_CELL_TABLE.json (hash-verified twice: entry bridge_cell() against the K1R4 checkpoint, identity resolver against its pin)

output_record.certificate_identity: identity_k1r6.canonical_identity: identity4 field list and IDENTITY_KIND unchanged; cells_sha256 + cell geometry from the bridge table; checkpoint_hash / obligation_universe_total inherited

k1r6_bridge.identity_cells_sha256: sha256 = exact K1R4 CUSUM bridge-table hash (CELL_PROVENANCE)

zero_case.firings: [{seq, object, part in {low, high, plus_tail, minus_tail}, reason, call_chain}]

output_record.scientific_hash: hash_v2.record_scientific_hash (frozen, by EXCLUSION): every non-incidental leaf is hashed, so k1r6_bridge -- including the deterministic zero_case firing record -- IS inside scientific_content_hash by this schema's definition. The firing record carries no timing and no counter; it is a deterministic function of the certified inputs.
